description: List a website's pages from its sitemap: reads robots.txt (sitemaps, allow/disallow rules for all crawlers, crawl-delay), then the sitemap(s), following sitemap indexes and .gz files, and returns page URLs with last-modified dates. Use before crawling or summarising a site, to find new or updated pages, or to check what crawlers may access. Send a site URL or a sitemap URL; optional limit (default 1000, max 5000). Errors: 400 bad or private URL. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

url.description: Website (any page) or a sitemap .xml URL

name: sitemap_reader
title: Sitemap and robots.txt reader
